events.verdict: Smart (BOS) makes contact to Redick (PHI) as he attempts to get to the lane after the release of the jump shot, but the contact is marginal.
Redick (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Morris (BOS) and absorbs the contact during the screen.
Horford (BOS) extends his knee forward and makes contact to the back of Redick's (PHI) leg which causes him to make contact with Smart (BOS).
Horford (BOS) makes contact to the arm of Simmons (PHI) after Simmons loses control of the loose ball. The contact does not affect Simmons ability to recover the loose ball.
Tatum (BOS) makes contact to the arm of Butler (PHI) during his shooting motion that affects his jump shot attempt.
{Enhanced Video} Morris (BOS) enters the lane prior to the release of the free throw shot by Butler (PHI).
Horford (BOS) puts his arm into the path of Simmons (PHI) during the screen, but the contact is marginal.
{Enhanced Video} Horford (BOS) lifts his pivot foot at the start of his dribble.
Harris (PHI) places a hand to the front of Horford (BOS) at the start of the drive but the contact does not affect his SQBR.

events.category: Turnover: Out of Bounds - Bad Pass Turn
events.verdict: Hayward (BOS) throws the ball out of bounds.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Smart (BOS) and absorbs the contact during the screen.
Embiid (PHI) slightly extends his arm to the body of Tatum (BOS), but does not affect his ability to defend.
Butler (PHI) does not come to a complete stop as he runs into Morris (BOS) during the pick, but the contact is marginal and does not dislodge him from his legally obtained position.
LAR shows Horford (BOS) makes contact to the arm of Embiid (PHI) during his shooting motion that affects his shot attempt.
Simmons (PHI) makes contact with Smart (BOS) during the start of the drive, but does not affect his SQBR.
Simmons (PHI) slightly extends his arm into the body of Hayward (BOS) off-ball, but the contact is marginal.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Brown (BOS) and absorbs the contact from Brown during the pick.
LAR shows Tatum (BOS) makes clean contact to the ball during Butler's (PHI) driving shot attempt.
{Enhanced Video} Horford (BOS) lifts his pivot foot.
Horford (BOS) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Harris (PHI) and absorbs the contact during the screen.
During the screen, Harris (PHI) and Horford (BOS) engage and disengage and the contact is marginal as Horford's SQBR is not affected.
LLS shows Harris (PHI) initially makes contact to the ball but slides it off and makes contact to Horford's (BOS) arm and affects his SQBR.
Redick (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Tatum (BOS) and absorbs the contact during the screen.
Embiid (PHI) establishes himself in a screening position in the path of Smart (BOS) and absorbs the contact as he firms up during the pick.
Horford (BOS) maintains a legal guarding position during the jump shot attempt by Harris (PHI).
Embiid (PHI) slightly extends his arm to the body of Tatum (BOS), but the contact is marginal.
Embiid (PHI) slightly extends his arm to the body of Brown (BOS) prior to his shot attempt near the rim, but the contact is marginal.
Scott (PHI) commits a take foul on Tatum (BOS).
